title: Double Drip 10K Lemon & Lime Prefilled Vape Pods + Refill
description: This Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack is designed for use with the Double Drip 10K Pod Kit, offering an easy and efficient way to replenish your favourite flavour. Each pack contains a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill bottle of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, delivering up to 10,000 puffs per device (depending on use), with reliably smooth performance. Lemon & Lime delivers a classic citrus duo, combining the zesty brightness of Lemon with the sharp, tangy edge of Lime. The result is a bold, sparkling vape that’s both fresh and fruity. To refresh your device, simply insert the new pod and refill bottle—no mess, no refilling, no hassle. The auto-refill system does the work for you, ensuring a consistent flavour hit with every puff.
